provenance.paper_title: Vision to Geometry: 3D Spatial Memory for Sequential Embodied MLLM Reasoning and Exploration

evidence.paraphrase: Stores representative spatial data rather than all redundant observations.; Uses FoV-based constraints as explicit geometric cues for memory construction.; Memory is accumulated from previous explorations and carried into later tasks.. spatial memory reused across sequential tasks to guide exploration.

During operation, Vision to Geometry / 3DSPMR applies fixed-rule insertion or replacement to Compact representative spatial memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

During operation, Vision to Geometry / 3DSPMR applies relinking or reindexing of stored items to Compact representative spatial memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

During operation, Vision to Geometry / 3DSPMR applies merging or deduplication of overlapping entries to Compact representative spatial memory; the memory state changes while the governing update policy remains fixed.

derived.hybrid_relation: Distinct operative representation paths are deliberately linked or jointly consumed by downstream reasoning, generation, or control.

adjudication_notes: Strict-tier full-paper review (PDF p. 5): During inference, the operative memory component (Compact representative spatial memory) changes through fixed-rule insertion or replacement, relinking or reindexing of stored items, merging or deduplication of overlapping entries; the governing policy remains fixed, and any learning reported by the paper occurs before deployment. Training-time learning, when present, was not counted as T3.
